verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fireflies generates meeting notes, summaries, and action items (docs-10) and has an AskFred AI assistant for querying transcripts (docs-39), but nothing describes drafting a follow-up email that a sales lead could review and send in a couple of clicks. Missing for 10: any mention of an email-drafting feature, CRM/email integration for follow-ups, or sales-specific follow-up templates.
